source.note: public planner asset snapshot 2026-11-17; functions mt/ht/yt/St/Ct/wt, constants Z/Qe/Xe

vectors.description: Nothing set: code is just the header
Six spells + three distinct banishes in phase 0
Phase 0 and 3 used; phases 1 and 2 empty are serialised as null (inner), nothing trailing
Empty strings are kept inside rings/trinkets/amulets so main vs alternative positions survive
Legendary amulet identifier is the catalogue legends key (legendary:<spell>)
Stats are [index, value] pairs, index 0-based in the site order damage..gold
Accents, emoji (surrogate pair), newline, custom label, link
A label equal to the default is serialised as an empty first field

decodeCases.description: URL with ?p= (class is inside the payload)
URL with neither p nor b is rejected
digits and dashes with at least one dash = talents only
death_coil is a warlock spell: dropped silently on a warrior
a banish already in spells is dropped
a ring key in trinkets becomes an empty hole
duplicate ring: the second occurrence becomes a hole, position kept
legendary key of another class is dropped to a hole
stats: >0 finite only, rounded to 1 decimal, capped 999
